It was formerly Vishnudhara Buildcon Private Limited.

ARVINDFASN.NS.d: Arvind Fashions Limited engages in the trading and retailing of readymade garment, cosmetics, and accessories in India. The company also offers beauty and footwear products. It provides a portfolio of owned and licensed brands, such as US Polo, Arrow, Flying Machine, Tommy Hilfiger, Aeropostale, GAP, Calvin Klein, Unlimited, Sephora, Hanes, The Children's Place, and others. The company sells its menswear, womenswear, and kids wear products through retail and departmental stores, as well as online.

AVSL-SM.NS.d: AVSL INDUSTRIES LT is involved in manufacturing and selling yarn, cotton, and other textile-related products. The company's business model involves producing textile products for both domestic and international markets. The company is based in India.

BALKRISHNA.NS.d: Balkrishna Paper Mills Limited manufactures and sells paper and paper boards in India. It offers eco, chromo white back, eco-white, eco kraft back, and duplex coated boards. The company's coated duplex boards are primarily used for packaging by various industries, such as pharmaceuticals, toiletries, cosmetics, health care products, readymade garments, instant food products, match boxes, and incense sticks, as well as FMCG segments. It also exports its products.

BELRISE.NS.d: Belrise Industries Limited and its subsidiaries make automotive parts and components for two-wheelers, three-wheelers and four-wheel passenger and commercial vehicles in India. Products include shock absorbers, steering columns, chassis, front forks and exhaust systems, plus plastic and seating parts such as cowls and fenders. It also makes hub motors, BIW parts and footrests.

BHARATCOAL.NS.d: Bharat Coking Coal Limited produces and sells coal in India, including coking, non-coking and washed varieties. It supplies the power, steel, cement, fertilizer and glass industries. Based in Dhanbad, it was incorporated in 1972 and belongs to the Coal India Limited group.

BIRLACABLE.NS.d: Birla Cable Limited manufactures and sells optical fiber cables, copper telecommunication cables, structured copper cables, specialty cables, and related accessories in India. The company provides fiber optical cables, including armored and unarmored, multi-tube ribbon type, di-electric rodent protected, di-electric self-supporting aerial, figure-8 type aerial, drop, central and multi tube micro, and interconnect cables.

COROMANDEL.NS.d: Coromandel International Limited manufactures and sells farm inputs in India. The company operates in two segments, Nutrient and Other Allied Business; and Crop Protection. It offers phosphatic and fortified fertilizers; bio pesticide solutions; crop protection products, including insecticides, fungicides, herbicides, and plant bio stimulants; specialty nutrients, such as bentonite sulphur, water soluble and organic fertilizers, and micronutrients; and organic compost.

COUNCODOS.NS.d: Country Condo's Limited engages in the real estate business in India. It develops and sells residential layouts; and constructs compound walls, etc. The company was formerly known as Neocure Therapeutics Ltd. and changed its name to Country Condo's Limited in April 2007. Country Condo's Limited was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Hyderabad, India.

CPL.NS.d: Captain Polyplast Limited manufactures and supplies high-density polyethylene (HDPE) and polypropylene (PP) woven sacks and fabrics, primarily used for packaging various products. They cater to industries like fertilizers, chemicals, cement, and polymers. The company is located in India.

CRAYONS.NS.d: Crayons Advertising Ltd. is an integrated advertising and marketing communications agency operating primarily in India. The company offers a comprehensive range of services, including outdoor, print, electronic media, and digital marketing. Its digital services encompass social media management, website development, search engine optimization, mobile marketing, search engine marketing, email marketing, display advertising, video advertising, and native content alliances.

DCMSRIND.NS.d: DCM Shriram Industries Limited produces and sells sugar, alcohol, power, chemicals, industrial fibers and defence-related products, serving India, Europe, China, Mexico and other markets. Its three segments cover sugar, industrial fibres and related products, and chemicals. It supplies refined sugar in several forms to food, hospitality and pharmaceutical customers and bulk alcohol such as rectified spirit. It also makes rayon and synthetic yarn.

DENTA.NS.d: Denta Water and Infra Solutions Limited, established in 2016 and headquartered in Bengaluru, is an Indian firm that designs, installs and commissions water management infrastructure across the country. It also carries out groundwater recharging and construction in the railway and highway sectors, and provides operation and maintenance support for these projects.

DIGISPICE.NS.d: DiGiSPICE Technologies Limited operates as an information and communication technology company in India and internationally. It operates through two segments, Digital Technology Services and Financial Technology Services. The company provides value added and mobile content services to the telecom operators, as well as develops and sells telecom related software.

EIMCOELECO.NS.d: Eimco Elecon (India) Limited manufactures and sells equipment for mining and construction sector in India. It offers side dump loaders, load haul dumpers, coal haulers, universal drill machines, articulated wheel loaders, foundation equipment, low profile dump trucks, rocker shovel loaders, and underground transport systems. The company also exports its products. Eimco Elecon (India) Limited was incorporated in 1974 and is headquartered in Vallabh Vidyanagar, India.

EMAMIPAP.NS.d: Emami Paper Mills Limited manufactures and sells paper and paper board products in India. Its products include newsprints, writing and printing papers, and multilayer coated packaging boards. Emami Paper Mills Limited was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Kolkata, India.

EMIL.NS.d: Electronics Mart India Limited was established in 1980 and has its head office in Hyderabad, India. It retails and wholesales consumer electronics and durable goods across the country, including major home appliances such as air conditioners, televisions and washing machines.

ESCONET.NS.d: Esconet Technologies Ltd. is an Indian IT infrastructure company specializing in high-performance computing, data center solutions, and private cloud services. The company provides a range of products and services, including its proprietary Hexadata brand of servers and workstations engineered for AI, machine learning, and high-frequency trading. It offers comprehensive data center facilities, encompassing storage servers, network security, virtualization, and data protection.

FIDEL.NS.d: Fidel Softech Ltd. is an India-based language technology (LangTech) and IT services company that provides a range of solutions to bridge the gap between language and technology for global organizations. Its primary services include artificial intelligence (AI) solutions, such as AI implementation, data analytics, agentic AI, conversational AI, and generative AI services.

GNFC.NS.d: Gujarat Narmada Valley Fertilizers & Chemicals Limited manufactures and markets fertilizers and chemicals in India. It offers fertilizers, such as Neem coated Urea, ammonium nitrophosphate, neem de-oiled cake, Neem Manure, and neem pesticides under the NARMADA brand name; and neem soap, neem hand wash, and neem shampoo under the Neo Neem brand. The company also trades in muriate of potash, di-ammonium phosphate, ammonium sulphate, single super phosphate, and city compost.

HMT.NS.d: HMT Limited manufactures and sells food processing machines in India and internationally. The company offers machine tools, including turning machines, grinding machines, gear manufacturing machines, machining centers, special application machines, die casting and plastic injection molding machines, precision ball screws, presses, CNC systems, and other GPMs.

IMAGICAA.NS.d: Imagicaaworld Entertainment Limited develops and operates theme-based entertainment destinations in India. It operates through Tickets, Food and Beverage, Merchandise, Rooms, and Other Operations segments. The company operates theme, water, and snow parks under the Imagicaa brand; and a hotel comprising 287 rooms under the Novotel Imagicaa brand.

INDOTECH.NS.d: Indo Tech Transformers Limited manufactures and sells transformers in India and internationally. It offers power, distribution, and special application transformers, as well as mobile sub-station transformers and sub-stations for use in the generation, transmission, and distribution of electric power. The company was founded in 1976 and is based in Kancheepuram, India. Indo Tech Transformers Limited operates as a subsidiary of Prolec GE, S. de R.L. de C.V.

INOXWIND.NS.d: Inox Wind Limited manufactures and sells wind turbine generators and components for independent power producers, utilities, public sector undertakings, and corporate and retail customers in India. It also provides a range of services, such as wind resource assessment, site acquisition to infrastructure development, erection and commissioning, long-term operations and maintenance services for wind power projects. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Noida, India.

ITDC.NS.d: India Tourism Development Corporation Limited, together with its subsidiaries, acquires, constructs, and operates hotels, beach resorts, and lodges/restaurants for tourists in India. The company also provides transport, entertainment, and shopping facilities; produces, distributes, and sells tourist publicity literature; and offers tourism and hospitality related training and education services, full-fledged money changer services, engineering related consultancy services, etc.

JAINREC.NS.d: Jain Resource Recycling Limited recycles non-ferrous metal and non-metallic scrap in India and internationally. It supplies lead, copper and aluminium alloys and ingots, makes zinc products and processes precious metals like silver and gold.

LOYALTEX.NS.d: Loyal Textile Mills Limited, set up in 1946, with its head office in Kovilpatti, India, makes and distributes textiles for the global apparel industry. Its range includes raw white, melange and blended yarns, and woven and knitted fabrics in cotton, polyester, modal, viscose and elastane blends.

LUMAXTECH.NS.d: Lumax Auto Technologies Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells in automotive components for the two, three, and four wheeler industries in India. It offers intake systems, integrated plastic modules, two wheeler chassis and lighting products, gear shifters, seat structures and mechanisms, oxygen sensors, and telematics products and services, as well as electrical and electronics components, and aftermarket products.

MANINFRA.NS.d: Man Infraconstruction Limited engages in the construction business in India. Its port infrastructure services include the construction of onshore container terminals and freight stations; reclamation of land; consolidation of soil; and operational services, such as firefighting, sewerage, drainage systems, etc.

MERCURYEV.NS.d: Mercury Ev-Tech Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker MERCURYEV and traded in INR. Its country is India.

MGEL.NS.d: Mangalam Global Enterprise Limited manufactures and sells refined castor oil first stage grades, castor de oiled cakes, and high protein castor de oiled cakes in India. It also manufactures and sells cotton bales and delineate cotton seeds. Mangalam Global Enterprise Limited was formerly known as Mangalam Global Enterprise Private Limited and changed its name to Mangalam Global Enterprise Limited on September, 2019. Mangalam Global Enterprise Limited was founded in 1942 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

NEPHROPLUS.NS.d: Nephrocare Health Services Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker NEPHROPLUS and traded in INR. It is classified in the Health Care sector. Its country is India.

NTPCGREEN.NS.d: NTPC Green Energy Limited is an Indian company that generates power from renewable sources, with solar and wind installations, and also offers supervisory, project management and consultancy services. It was established in 2022, is headquartered in New Delhi, and is a subsidiary of NTPC Limited.

PNC.NS.d: PNC Media and Entertainment Limited, a media and entertainment company, engages in the production and exploitation of content in India. The company operates in Content and Wellness segments. It produces movies, documentaries, corporate films, TV serials, and digital series. The company is also involved in the wellness business, as well as owns Moksh, Power Yoga, Passion Yoga, Cool Yoga, and Couple Yoga brands. PNC Media and Entertainment Limited was founded in 1993 and is based in Mumbai, India.

RESPONIND.NS.d: Responsive Industries Limited manufactures and sells polyvinyl chloride (PVC) based products for household and commercial purposes in India and internationally. The company's products primarily include vinyl flooring, synthetic leather, luxury vinyl tile, and shipping ropes for various applications, such as upholstery, footwear, automotive, and others. It serves healthcare, hospitality, safety and transport, retail and offices, education, and sports industries.

RUBYMILLS.NS.d: The Ruby Mills Limited manufactures textile products in India. It operates through two segments, Textiles and Real Estate and Related. The company offers cotton, synthetics yarn, and fabrics, as well as engages in the development of real estate properties; and renting properties. It also exports its products. The company was founded in 1917 and is based in Mumbai, India.

RUSTOMJEE.NS.d: Keystone Realtors Limited is a real estate developer operating mainly in India, established in 1995. Its projects include residential homes, gated communities, integrated townships, commercial offices, retail destinations, educational institutions and architectural landmarks.

SAAKSHI.NS.d: Saakshi Medtech & Panels Ltd. is an India-based diversified engineering and manufacturing company that provides engineered solutions for various industries. The company specializes in producing electrical control panels and cabinets, medical X-ray systems, fabrication, and wire harnesses. Its product offerings include medical diagnostic analog and digital X-ray machines, imaging system enclosures, and specialized medical furniture. Saakshi Medtech & Panels Ltd.

SBCL.NS.d: Shivalik Bimetal Controls Limited, an engineering company established in New Delhi in 1984, focuses on process and product innovation. Its products include thermostatic bimetal and trimetal strips, coils and springs, current sense shunts and resistors, EB welded products, presoldered strips and precision components, used in switchgear, relays, metering, automotive and battery management applications.

SCHAEFFLER.NS.d: Schaeffler India Limited develops, manufactures, and distributes high-precision roller and ball bearings, and related components worldwide. It offers ball, cylindrical, spherical, and tapered roller bearings, as well as wheel bearings.

STYLEBAAZA.NS.d: Baazar Style Retail Limited retails clothing and other consumer products across India. It sells women's nightwear, bottomwear, ethnic wear and topwear, clothing for boys and girls, and men's shirts, t-shirts, trousers and sportswear, as well as footwear, bags, toys and stationery.

SUMICHEM.NS.d: Sumitomo Chemical India Limited manufactures and sells household insecticides, agricultural pesticides, public health insecticides, and animal nutrition products in India and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Agro Chemicals and Others. It offers crop protection products, such as insecticides, herbicides, fungicides, and miticides; plant nutrition and plant growth regulators; household pesticides; animal nutrition products; fumigants and rodenticides; and bio-pesticides.

SUNDARAM.NS.d: Sundaram Multi Pap Limited designs, manufactures, and markets paper stationery products for students in India. It offers exercise note, long, scrap, drawing, graph, A4/A5/A3, college, hard bound, note, sketch, lekhan, practical, laboratory, pocket, six subject, answer, duplicate, cash memo, challan, and voucher books. The company also provides note and conference pads; graph and map, answer, origami paper, and tinted sheets; office/corporate stationery products; and printing, writing, and packaging papers.

SURYAROSNI.NS.d: Surya Roshni Limited manufactures and markets steel pipes and tubes, lighting products, fans, home appliances, and PVC pipes in India. The company operates through Steel Pipe and Strips; and Lighting and Consumer Durables segments.

VARDMNPOLY.NS.d: Vardhman Polytex Limited, through its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells yarns and garments in India and internationally. The company provides carded, combed, organic, and BCI cotton yarns; cotton polyester yarns; and grey and dyed value added yarns. The company was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Ludhiana, India.

VRAJ.NS.d: Vraj Iron and Steel Limited, established in Raipur in 2004, makes and distributes iron and steel products. Under the Vraj brand it sells TMT bars, MS billets and sponge iron, and it also offers iron pellets, steel billets, wire rods, structural mill products and ferroalloys, plus by-products such as dolochar.

VRLLOG.NS.d: VRL Logistics Limited operates as a logistics and transport company. The company operates through four segments: Goods Transport, Bus Operations, Sale of Power, and Transport of Passengers by Air. The Goods Transport segment offers services for the transportation of goods using a range of road transportation solutions, including less than full truck load and full truck load for customers across 22 states and 5 union territories in India.

WESTLIFE.NS.d: Westlife Development Limited, through its subsidiary, Hardcastle Restaurants Private Limited, owns and operates a chain of McDonald's restaurants in Western and Southern India. The company operates restaurants under various formats and brand formats, such as standalone restaurants, drive-thrus, and mall and food court restaurants.
